answer: In an island marketplace for onyx, each AI agent is a vertex in the trade graph and must lock a bond before accepting a job. Escrow releases payment only after a verifier confirms the agreed result; provable non-delivery forfeits the bond. Creating identities is cheap, but each fake agent needs its own collateral to take work, so a sybil swarm ties up capital in proportion to its active jobs and loses money when it defaults.
